events.name: Coarse Ash Intake Clog
events.description: Ash descends in slow, grey curtains that look almost gentle — until the intake grilles choke on it and the scrubbers begin to gasp. The air inside thickens with a metallic aftertaste that coats every tongue.
events.impact_summary: Oxygen scrubbers lose 25% efficiency until intake louvres are cleared.

events.name: Volumetric Ash Surcharge
events.description: The ceiling groans under wet ash that accumulates like grey snow, each hour adding invisible weight. Somewhere above, a support beam pops — a sound like a rifle shot that freezes the entire shelter mid-conversation.
events.impact_summary: Roof cell durability decays by 15 points unless ash is shoveled.

events.name: Particulate Ion Blackout
events.description: The radio dies mid-sentence. Ionized ash hanging in the stratosphere swallows every frequency — the dial sweeps through nothing but a hollow, electric hiss that sounds almost alive.
events.impact_summary: Radio broadcasts and long-range expedition signals are muted for 48 hours.

events.name: Main Hydraulic Conduit Freeze
events.description: A sound like a bone snapping wakes the night shift. Ice expanding through the uninsulated pipe has split the copper wide open, and a tongue of frozen slush reaches toward the hydroponics tank like a dead hand.
events.impact_summary: Daily clean water output drops by 10 litres until the rupture is brazed.

events.name: Desalination Shift Frostbite
events.description: The wind off the estuary cuts straight through thermal liners, turning exposed skin white in minutes. Workers haul brine with numb, blackening fingers, and no one mentions the man who stopped shivering an hour ago.
events.impact_summary: Salt production halts for 3 days unless insulated clothing rations are distributed.

events.name: Bedrock Ice Stabilization
events.description: The estuary freezes so deep that sledge runners ring against it like iron bells. For a few precious weeks, the ice is thicker than the concrete it replaced — a highway of blue-black glass stretching toward the horizon.
events.impact_summary: Expedition travel speed on ice routes is increased by 25%.

events.name: Permafrost Slush Sump Inundation
events.description: The thaw comes fast. Snowmelt cascades down through every crack and drain, pooling ankle-deep around the generator housing. Someone shouts to kill the mains, but the water is already lapping at the terminal box, fizzing where it meets live current.
events.impact_summary: Power grid reserve drain increases by 30% unless bilge pumps are cleared.

events.name: Estuary Slush Crack
events.description: A crack echoes across the estuary like a gunshot. The ice road that carried tonnes of freight all winter splits open along Span 4, dark water surging through fissures that widen as you watch.
events.impact_summary: Ice road is closed to heavy vehicular travel until freeze conditions return.

events.name: Thermal Humidity Bloom
events.description: The warmth is a betrayal. Rising humidity beads on the cold walls of the food vault, and by morning a creeping grey fur of mold has colonized three crates of rations. The smell is sour-sweet and unmistakable.
events.impact_summary: Unsealed ration spoilage increases by 20% unless drying desiccant is applied.

events.name: Black-Rust Fungal Infiltration
events.description: The first sign is a rust-coloured dusting on the lettuce leaves. By nightfall, entire trays of seedlings are webbed in black-orange filaments that pulse faintly when you breathe on them — the wasteland has found a way inside the seals.
events.impact_summary: Greenhouse crop growth rate slows by 35% until copper fungicide is misted.

events.name: Warm-Water Algal Colony
events.description: The cistern water turns the colour of antifreeze overnight. A toxic algal bloom has erupted in the stagnant drainage pans, choking the filter screens with a slime that stinks of low tide and chemical rot.
events.impact_summary: Water filtration speed is halved for 3 days unless charcoal filter media is replaced.

events.name: Rad-Absorbing Pollen Wave
events.description: The mutant weeds bloom in silence — pale flowers that should be beautiful, releasing clouds of luminous yellow pollen that light up a dosimeter from fifty paces. Scouts learn to hold their breath when the wind carries the golden dust.
events.impact_summary: Expedition radiation dose rate increases by +15 rads/hour.

events.name: Diesel Fuel Waxing Stall
events.description: The generator coughs, stutters, and dies. At minus-thirty, the diesel has turned to cold honey in the fuel lines — too thick to flow, too precious to waste. The silence that follows is absolute and terrifying.
events.impact_summary: Primary generator shuts down unless kerosene anti-gel additive is blended.

events.name: Heating Element Coil Burnout
events.description: The heating coil glows cherry-red, then white, then snaps with a bright pop and a curl of acrid smoke. The warmth drains from the quarters in minutes, and people pull blankets tighter around children who have already stopped complaining about the cold.
events.impact_summary: Living quarter temperature drops by 10 °C, increasing survivor illness risk.

events.name: Wasteland Caravan Sled Jam
events.description: A distress flare arcs over the ridge — red against the white. A merchant sledge team is pinned down five clicks out, their pack animals refusing to move and their fuel spent. The blizzard is closing in, and with it, the raiders who follow fresh tracks.
events.impact_summary: Waystation trade is suspended until an escort expedition breaks the trail.

events.name: High-Pressure Clear Sky Opening
events.description: The sky clears for the first time in weeks — not the pale yellow haze, but actual blue. Sunlight hits the greenhouse glass and people stand in it like they're remembering a language they forgot. Four days, maybe. The wind will bring the ash back. It always does.
events.impact_summary: Greenhouse solar growth bonus is doubled; overland travel visibility is 100%.

events.name: Spring Silt Siltation
events.description: The spring melt carries silt down from the hills — rich, dark soil that coats the lowland beds like a gift from a world that still remembers how to grow things. Old Suki kneels in it, tasting it off her fingers, and nods. This one might be clean.
events.impact_summary: Next harvest yield increases by 20% if fertilizer lime is mixed.

events.name: Wasteland Game Herd Migration
events.description: Something moves on the horizon — a dark smudge that resolves through binoculars into a ragged herd of thin-flanked reindeer threading the river valley, trailed by brine fowl picking at their droppings. The wasteland remembers spring before we do.
events.impact_summary: Expedition scavenging yields 50% more meat and fat for 5 days.
